# Cathay Cargo

> Cathay Cargo is a leading air freight and specialized cargo logistics provider offering temperature-controlled pharma shipping, live animal transport, dangerous goods handling, express courier services, and digital innovation through AI and IATA ONE Record.

Cathay Cargo operates as part of the Cathay Group with global network capabilities, including major hubs in Hong Kong and Anchorage. The company specializes in regulated and time-sensitive shipments across healthcare, livestock, hazardous materials, and e-commerce sectors.

## Key Topics

- Air freight
- Cathay Pharma

## Specialized Cargo Solutions

- [Cathay Pharma | Healthcare logistics](https://www.cathaycargo.com/en-us/solutions/cathay-pharma.html): Temperature-controlled solution for vaccines and medicines with regulated healthcare logistics
- [Cathay Live Animal | Animal logistics](https://www.cathaycargo.com/en-us/solutions/cathay-live-animal.html): IATA-certified solution for pet and livestock transport with specialized animal welfare standards
- [Cathay Dangerous Goods | Chemical logistics](https://www.cathaycargo.com/en-us/solutions/cathay-dangerous-goods.html): Hazmat and lithium batteries shipping with full regulatory compliance
- [Cathay Courier | Time-Sensitive Shipping](https://www.cathaycargo.com/en-us/solutions/cathay-courier.html): Express service for time-sensitive and e-commerce shipments with rapid delivery
- [Cathay Expert | Custom Cargo Solutions](https://www.cathaycargo.com/en-us/solutions/cathay-expert.html): Custom logistics for specialized, fragile, and heavyweight shipments requiring expert handling
